description.narrative: Det gemensamma programmet påskyndar framstegen mot de globala målen för hållbar utveckling (SDG:erna) i Bosnien och Hercegovina genom att stärka integrerade styrningssystem och stärka nyckelaktörer i arbetet med att lokalisera Agenda 2030. Genom systemövergripande innovationer och samhällsdrivna lösningar förbättrar programmet den politiska samstämmigheten, främjar dynamiska partnerskap – särskilt med den privata sektorn – och fungerar som katalysator för de transformativa reformer som är avgörande för en hållbar och inkluderande tillväxt.

The Joint Programme accelerates progress toward the SDGs in Bosnia and Herzegovina by strengthening integrated governance systems and empowering key stakeholders to localize the 2030 Agenda. Through system-level innovations and community-driven solutions, the Programme enhances policy coherence, fosters dynamic partnerships—particularly with the private sector—and catalyzes transformative reforms essential for sustainable and inclusive growth.

The overall objective of the Joint Programme (JP) is to contribute to the accelerated achievement of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) by strengthening systemic, integrated governance and empowering citizens, the private sector, and academia to localize the SDGs, thus increasing sustainable and inclusive growth. The Programme is organized around two strategically aligned and mutually reinforcing outcomes, with corresponding outputs: The programme proposal aims to operate on two outcome levels:
1. Authorities at all levels adopt sustainable development approaches to policy design, financing, and implementation, powered by data, innovative solutions, and collaboration with businesses, academia, and financial institutions and
2. Local governments, businesses and communities create and implement solutions for shared challenges, with the private sector contributing to inclusive growth and sustainable development.
Under each outcome level there are two expected outputs - four in total:
1.1. Coherent, inclusive and gender responsive policy design and implementation system in place at all levels of governance and 1.2. Enhanced frameworks for accelerating SDG investments institutionalized-
2.1. A sustainable, inclusive and accountable local government system in place that strengthens people-centered and collaborative governance, ensuring responsive and equitable service delivery. and 2.2. Regulatory, institutional, and innovation support mechanism established to enhance private sector competitiveness, sustainability and market access.
